minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  April 27, 2020

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the 1st Floor, Finance Conference
Room at 11:39 a.m.:

  Members Present: Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Charles Meremikwu, City Treasurer
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk

  Staff Present:  Stephanie Maldonado – Parks and Rec
  Debra Carter- City Attorney

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of April 06, 2020, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Daniel Macias - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for the dance
  classes at the Veterans Memorial Building in the amount of $317.60. Motion carried
  unanimously.

  3. Fleet Maintenance Specialist, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommended
  payment for the inspection of eight new paratransit vehicles for the city’s Senior Center
  Transportation Division in the amount of $4,000.00. Motion carried unanimously.

  Closed Session- Confidential
  4. USAA a/s/o Gregory Anderson City of Inglewood- A motion was moved and second to
  recommend settlement on claim for damages.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting
  adjourned at 11:47 a.m. Adjournment
